boards.name: Kwork
boards.business_model: No paid accounts or subscriptions for sellers. Kwork charges a percentage fee on completed orders.

sources.title: For Freelancers - Kwork
sources.quote: there are no paid accounts or subscriptions; we only charge a percentage fee for completed orders.

reviews.name: Kleinanzeigen
reviews.note: About page gives the Adevinta parent and the PRO subscription price is on the PRO package page. The site does not state the headquarters country, and no partner program statement was found on the pages read. Business model covers the PRO subscription; private listings are free.

reviews.name: ClearanceJobs
reviews.note: No founding year stated. The home page says 'Since 2002, over 1.9 million cleared candidates have joined', which describes candidate sign-ups, not the founding, so it was not recorded as founded. Recruitment solution and request-demo pages give no prices or pricing model, only a demo request form.

reviews.name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
reviews.note: The About page returned HTTP 403 Access Denied to the fetch tool and the headless reader reported blocked. No quote was recorded. The Developers and Public Data API pages were not read.

reviews.name: HireVue
reviews.note: Integrations and Certified Integration Partner Program pages describe pre-built ATS integrations and a partner program, but no public API, API key, developer or partner-only API access is stated. Developer and API pages were not linked from the pages read, so api_status is unknown rather than none-known.

reviews.name: Kwork
reviews.note: The For Sellers page states the fee model. The fee applies to sellers on completed orders, not to employers, so it describes the seller side of the marketplace.
